summary: Verified NEW feature POST /api/inventory/customers/broadcast-whatsapp + BroadcastWAModal on Inventory→Customer tab. Backend 14/14 pytest pass covering: message validation (empty/whitespace/>3000char → 400), unauth (401/403), preview_only mode returns {preview_only,total_selected,total_with_phone,skipped_no_phone,sample_targets}, actual send returns {total,sent,failed,mocked,skipped_no_phone,results[]}, {name} variable replacement (verified via db.whatsapp_logs.message_preview), customers without phone skipped and counted in skipped_no_phone, customer_ids=[] targets ALL active-with-phone customers, db.whatsapp_logs written per send with type='customer_broadcast'+customer_id+customer_name+phone+message_preview+status+reason+sent_at+sent_by. CRUD regression (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE customers) and Sales POST regression (with material seed + auto-created customer flow) both green. Frontend Playwright verified: green 'Broadcast WA' button with badge count 3 (2 seeded + PT Test Advertising), disabled state respected; modal opens with all data-testid elements present (broadcast-message, broadcast-preview, broadcast-select-all, broadcast-send-button, 3× broadcast-recipient); default template contains '{name}' and 'banner Flexy' promo copy; live-preview replaces {name}→'Pak Budi'; send button disabled when message empty AND when no recipients selected; select-all toggles all checkboxes; recipient search 'Budi' filters to 1 correctly; window.confirm dialog shown; POST fires and results modal shows Total/Terkirim/Gagal/Mocked cards + per-customer status rows; toast '0 terkirim, 3 gagal' displayed. NOTE: FONNTE_TOKEN IS set in preview .env — real Fonnte API called but returns 'request invalid on disconnected device' (Fonnte device unlinked). This is EXPECTED preview behavior; endpoint returns status='failed' with reason string correctly, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file now 4797 lines — long-standing monolith. Consider splitting into modules (auth/sales/inventory/payroll/marketing). Not introduced by this feature but continues to grow.

customers_broadcast_whatsapp() has no rate-limit protection against a super_admin accidentally spamming: no cooldown, no daily quota check. With 0.3s pacing a 1000-customer broadcast takes 5min and holds the request open the whole time (no background task). Consider FastAPI BackgroundTasks or a real job queue (Celery/RQ) for reliability + async progress reporting. Non-blocking for small customer base.

The endpoint keeps HTTP request open for entire duration of send loop (asyncio.sleep 0.3s × N). For N=100 customers that's 30+ seconds — browsers may abort. Consider streaming response (SSE) or async task pattern.
db.whatsapp_logs write is best-effort inside try/except: log failures are silently swallowed. Fine for MVP but should surface some visibility (logger.warning) in case Mongo becomes unavailable.
Frontend BroadcastWAModal recomputes 'preview' every render via message.replace on line 1357 — fine at current scale but could be memoized (useMemo) if messages get long. Trivial.

Frontend does not disable the modal itself while sending — user can click 'Batal' mid-send which may leave UI in inconsistent state. Not critical, since sending=true disables send button and re-clicking Batal just closes modal (result still hits state). Consider disabling close during send.

Missing endpoint /api/admin/whatsapp/logs or similar to VIEW past broadcasts in-app. Backend writes logs but there's no UI/API to retrieve them. Would help ops audit which customers received which promo.
No idempotency key on broadcast POST — a browser retry could double-send. Given super_admin only + confirm dialog, low risk, but consider a client-generated request_id.

MOCKED case handling: since FONNTE_TOKEN is set in this preview but device is disconnected, results come back 'failed' (not 'mocked'). The frontend toast copy 'Fonnte token belum diset' shown when mocked > 0 — accurate. But when failed>0 and mocked=0 (this scenario), the yellow ResultCard warning banner is not shown, so ops must read the per-row 'reason' column to diagnose. Consider showing a general failure banner too.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button + badge + modal + preview live-render + send flow + confirm + result card + cleanup all verified)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature validated as working. Only observation: FONNTE_TOKEN is set in preview .env but device is disconnected → all real sends return 'failed'. Backend behavior is correct: it calls Fonnte, receives the error, returns status='failed' with the actual reason string. This is not a bug in the broadcast feature itself.
